name: Sargon
subtitle: The Wise
lore: Sargon may well have been the first to hold the title of emperor anywhere in the old world. Famous for consulting his advisors and considering all angles before each campaign, he now advises the kings of Ekur through Ryven’s many challenges. Slowly, he builds personal allegiances with military leaders, with an eye toward eventually reclaiming his position as emperor over Ekur.
